title: React v2 Mission Control: three-panel live operations screen with real run data, task output, AI proposals, and phase chain
goal: Build src/components/screens/MissionControl.tsx as a full three-panel screen. REQUIRES backlog-268 foundation (Zustand store + API client). The screen has three columns: LEFT PANEL (scan-map-panel, 30%): Shows discovered targets as nodes. When a run is selected, read inventory snapshot from store (hosts + endpoints). Render each discovered host as a positioned circle with hostname/IP label, colored by status (grey=discovered, cyan=active, green=completed, red=finding). If no run: show 'Start a new mission to see live scan activity here' with a single 'Start Mission Intake' button that navigates to /intake. If run but no inventory: show 'Discovery in progress...' with a loading spinner. Use SVG for the node graph — no external graph libraries. CENTRE PANEL (tasks-panel, 40%): Header shows: run profile name, run status badge (queued/running/completed), elapsed time. Phase chain strip: if run has assessment_chain_id, call GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/chain and show horizontal phase bar: Phase 1 [✓ done] → Phase 2 [⚡ active] → Phase 3 [⏳ approval needed] → Phase 4. Each phase node is a small pill. 'Approve Phase N' button appears when status=pending_phase_approval. Task list: call GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/tasks. Render each task as a row: [status-dot] [tool icon] [target] [status badge] [duration]. Clicking a task row expands it inline to show the last 500 chars of stdout_text from its latest execution (monospace, dark bg). Kill Run button (red) and Start Queued Checks button (primary) — both POST to /api/v1/runs/{id}/cancel and /api/v1/runs/{id}/dispatch respectively. RIGHT PANEL (ai-signal-panel, 30%): Header 'AI Signal'. Call GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/ai-insights on load. Show: pending proposal count badge. Proposals list: each proposal is a card showing tool, target, confidence bar (0-100), reasoning text (truncated to 3 lines, expand on click). Approve button (POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/proposals/{proposalId}/review with decision=approved) and Reject button (decision=rejected). Below proposals: last 3 AgentReasoning records (summary_text, thought_text). Show 'Select a run to see AI analysis' when no run selected. TOPBAR ACTIONS for this screen: Kill Run, Start Queued Checks, View Findings (→ /findings), Cinema Mode (opens CinemaMode component). LIVE UPDATES: poll GET /api/v1/runs/{runId} every 3 seconds when run status is 'running' or 'queued'. On new data, update store and re-render. Cinema Mode: when button clicked, open existing CinemaMode.tsx component overlaid but pass real run data from store instead of EVENT_STREAM mock.
scope: React v2 Mission Control replaces the old 7289-line mission-control.js. Must show real data from the AegisPT API. This is the primary operational screen.
generation_reason: Core operational screen for React v2. Must show live run data, tasks, AI proposals, and phase chain.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Build only Mission Control screen. No other screens in this task.

success_criteria: When run selected: left panel shows discovered host nodes from real inventory API.
Centre panel shows tasks from GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/tasks with correct status dots.
Clicking a task row expands stdout_text from latest execution.
Right panel shows AI proposals from GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/ai-insights.
Approve/Reject buttons POST to proposals review endpoint.
Phase chain strip shows phases when assessment_chain_id exists.
Kill Run button POSTs to cancel endpoint.
Empty state shown when no run selected.
Cinema Mode opens CinemaMode.tsx with real run data.

acceptance_criteria: Mission Control renders with real data.
